parameters.name: Query
parameters.description: A search keyword for fuzzy matching on the task ID or creator's name. A task ID can be a number or a string prefixed with `task_`.

parameters.name: Size
parameters.description: The number of entries to return per page. Default: 20. Maximum: 100.

parameters.name: SortOrder
parameters.description: The sort order. Valid values: `asc` (ascending) and `desc` (descending). Default: `desc`.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description: The task status to filter by.
